## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature you would like to see in Pixeller.

## Problem / Use Case
Is your feature request related to a problem or a specific workflow? (e.g. "I need to export specific bit-depth textures for game engine X").

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working or looking in the editor.

## Alternative Options
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.
